text:
samir: hey all, samir here (first day) 1 trying to build runtime from source on ubuntu 22.04 with cuda-12.0. cmake/ninja link fails with undefined symbols for `cusparseLtMatmul` and friends. any pointers? who should i ask for infra setup?
paige: welcome! :wave: can you paste the linker error and `nvcc --version`? also try `nvidia-smi` to check driver.
samir: nvcc: Cuda compilation tools, release 12.0, V12.0.226. link snippet:
```
/usr/bin/ld: build/third_party/libcublas/libcublas.so: undefined reference to `cusparseLtMatmul'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
omar: that symbol is from cuSPARSELt (part of newer CUBLAS/cuSPARSE stacks). check that libcublas version matches toolkit, and that `/usr/local/cuda-12.0/targets/x86_64-linux/lib` is on your LD_LIBRARY_PATH. run `ldd bin/runtime_local` to see resolution.
samir: `nvidia-smi` shows Driver Version: 510.39, ldd shows `libcublas.so.12 => /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublas.so.12` (system path), and libcublas in build/third_party is present.
paige: sounds like you have mixed installs: distro libcublas vs toolkit one. infra-bot: note: recommended on dev VMs is full runfile install for CUDA12 or install apt packages that include `libcublas-dev` and matching versions.
omar: remove the vendored libcublas (or prefer the system one) and make sure CMake links the correct libdir. also check `/etc/ld.so.conf.d/` entries. quick fix: set `CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-12.0` before reconfiguring.
samir: removed the vendored lib and set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH, reconfigured and link finished. build succeeded. thanks!
paige: great — welcome aboard. devex, we'll add a note about avoiding mixed libcublas installs in the onboarding doc.
infra-bot: FYI CI images use driver >= 515 for CUDA12.0.
